claims.evidence: File names as in PRIDE files/all; single-shot, unfractionated runs.

Digestion enzyme. Methods: liver lysate 'processed similar as described for the cell culture samples', i.e. Lys-C + trypsin digestion. Trypsin is written here. Lys-C has no column because comment[cleavage agent details] is single-cardinality in ms-proteomics v1.2.0 (see limitations). No mouse search was deposited; the Methods say 'strict trypsin specificity'.

limitations: Lys-C (MS:1001309) was used in the digestion (Methods) but has no column: comment[cleavage agent details] is single-cardinality in ms-proteomics v1.2.0, so sdrf-tools build emits only the first value. The SDRF was not hand-edited to add a second column. Rebuilding with Lys-C needs a build/contract change or a coordinator decision to override the template cardinality.
